fireAllHint: Every course starts in the kitchen as soon as the waiter sends it. No pass.
fireFirstHint: The 1st starts on its own, the rest wait to be fired from the pass.
fireNextHint: The next one starts on its own when you mark the previous one served.
fireManualHint: No course starts on its own: the expediter fires them all from the pass.
cardSubtitle: Orders, stations, screens, pass and printers.
profileOverwriteTitle: Overwrites the profile with the current setup
passOffToast: Pass: off — pacing to the floor, alert and served on the kitchen screen
autoReadyTitle: This station's lines mark themselves ready when fired
fullCourseTitle: The printed order also lists, in small type at the bottom, the dishes from the other stations in the same course
noCategories: No categories in the dish list.
buzzerOnTitle: Print buzzer on: tap to turn it off
buzzerOffTitle: Print buzzer off: tap to turn it on
proformaHint: itemised lines with a QR code at the bottom
qrSlipHint: code only, to leave on the table
authorityFrozenTitle: The node is offline: authority stays where it is until the line comes back
adminsOnly: Only administrators can change these settings.
profilesNote: A profile is a snapshot of firing mode, stations and printers. «Activate» applies it all at once; «detach» only drops the link, leaving the current configuration untouched.
passNote: On: firing and serving go through the Pass page (expediter). Off: the page disappears, the floor sets the pace with Call on the order, and the ready card on the kitchen screen shows the bell (alerts the floor) and the tick (served).
stationsNoteA: «Screen only» = the station works from the Kitchen screen. With a printer, firing the course also prints a paper order.
stationsNoteB: «Auto ready» = the station has no screen: its lines mark themselves ready when fired, so the course does not wait for them.
stationsNoteC: «Full course» = the paper also lists, in small type at the bottom, the dishes from the other stations in the same course — for whoever plates by seeing what goes out together.
uncoveredOneB: has no station: its dishes appear on no kitchen screen.
uncoveredMany: {{n}} categories with no station ({{elenco}}): their dishes appear on no kitchen screen.
categoriesNote: Dishes with no station of their own follow their category — including ones created later. It applies to orders sent from now on; an explicit station on a single dish always wins.
billRoutingNote: Station orders are routed above, centre by centre. Here you choose where the table's bill documents come out.
hybridModeNote: Orders, kitchen and pass run through the node on the venue's network: the screens stay alive even when the line drops.
fullServiceNote: Floor entries are created on the node and realign with the cloud on their own: you can work without internet.
nodeNote: The domain points to the node's LAN IP; the cloud distributes certificate and credentials. With full service off, writes go through the cloud; with it on, they are created on the node and realign on their own.
fiscalNote: The receipt stays with the till software: the direct link comes with Phase 2 (Passepartout integration). From here the CRM never sends anything to the fiscal printer.
profileUpdatedToast: Profile «{{nome}}» updated with the current setup
ownDishesOnlyToast: {{partita}}: own dishes only on the order
fullCourseToast: {{partita}}: the rest of the course on the order too
testSentToast: Test sent to «{{stampante}}» — check the printer
